name: Kurashima Migiwa
source: She is the daughter of Kurashima Nagisa from Izumo and a childhood friend of Kotono and Asuka. She is the reincarnation of Yamata no Orochi who took the control of Himiko and killed Susanoo in Izumo 2 too.
